blocks.text: 1. When the archon witnessed his size – and yet he saw no one but himself, seeing nothing further than water and darkness – he then imagined that he was the only one who existed.

2. His [...] was completed by means of verbal articulation, which ⟦page 101⟧ manifested itself as a spirit moving back and forth over the waters, and when that spirit had become manifest, the archon separated the aqueous substance, and what was dry was separated into a different place, and out of matter he fashioned for himself a dwelling-place, and he called it “Heaven,” and out of matter the archon fashioned a footstool, and he called it “Earth.”
3. A thought then occurred to the archon, agreeing with his nature, and by means of verbal articulation he created an androgyne.
4. He opened his mouth and made a cooing sound to him.
5. Upon his eyes being opened, he gazed at his father, to whom he made the sound “eee!”
6. His father then named him Eee-a-o.
7. He then created the second son, making a cooing sound to him, and upon opening his eyes, he made to his father the sound “eh!”
9. He then created the third son, making a cooing sound to him, and upon opening his eyes, he made to his father the sound “asss!”
11. These three are the sons of their father.
